text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking around the academy,
I saw Tokai Teio looking for something.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Pretty much. Actually, just earlier—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh~? Not here either...
I'm pretty sure she said she passed through here too...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Maybe while spinning a pen it flew off
and landed in a tree...? All right!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Stooooooop!
Don't 'all right' me, Tsuru-chan!
What do you think you're doing!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Teio-chan!
An underclassman dropped her pen!
So I'm helping her look for it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Tsuru-chan, you're way too good-natured, not to mention clumsy.
I just can't leave you alone, y'know?
choice_data_list: Wait, where did Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi go—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*... I ran all around the school building, but I can't find it anywhere~!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa-whoa... M-My head's starting to spin too...?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez! Tsuru-chan, you're overdoing it again!
Come on, take a breath and calm down!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah, hahaha~, so embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
But if an underclassman is in trouble, I gotta do my best as her senpai!
Working down to the bone... like a bakushin dash, y'know!
I understand your desire to push forward with all your might, but the correct phrase is 'working to the bone.'

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio & Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Kaicho-o-o?!
Student Council President?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please, allow me to assist as well.
Helping an underclassman in need is the duty of a senpai—is it not?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Our next schedule is stamping documents in the student council room.
There should be no issue with postponing that until tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If helping underclassmen is the duty of a senpai, then helping students is the duty of a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone! Thank you so much!
I can't believe you all did so much for me!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It was a suuuper important pen, right?
Don't lose it again, okay! Bye-by—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—*cough* *cough*!!
O-Of all times, I choked on air!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you don't have to rush like that.
She was hugging it so tight...
Your feelings definitely got through to her, Tsuru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: If this genius, super-clever Teio-sama says so, there's no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so! You're totally right!
Thanks, Teio-chan!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, it is nothing. The scene before my eyes simply felt rather radiant.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Lending a hand upon seeing a troubled student, facing hardships together to resolve them...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This academy is blessed with many kind-hearted students... and Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I feel as though I caught a glimpse of our bright future.
choice_data_list: I learned a lot from this too.
It was a good learning experience for me as well.
I can't wait to see that future.
I want to see that future soon.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I feel as though I caught a glimpse of our bright future.
choice_data_list: I learned a lot from this too.
It was a good learning experience for me as well.
I can't wait to see that future.
I want to see that future soon.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You as well? I too have gained much from this occasion.
Allow me to express my gratitude to the two of you once more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio & Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Yup!
...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed, quite so.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey! Did you just say 'fast'?! Are we gonna run now?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!! Tsuyoshi is ready to run anytime! I'm always doing my stretches!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! —That sounds fine as well!
